Puerto Rico has no recorded AI legislation as of September 2026, making it one of the few jurisdictions in the dataset with a completely blank slate.

The absence of bills does not mean AI activity is absent, only that no formal legislative response has been logged. The data covers enacted laws and introduced bills, so executive actions, agency guidance, or informal policy positions would not appear here.

What the data cannot say is whether this gap reflects deliberate restraint, limited legislative capacity, or simply that proposals exist but have not yet been filed in a trackable form. Readers drawing conclusions about Puerto Rico's regulatory environment should treat a count of zero as a boundary on the data, not a complete picture of the territory's posture toward AI.
